decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - This permission shall be for a limited period expiring on 22 January 2006 when the building shall be removed and the land reinstated to an acceptable Green Belt use in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority.

Condition : 2 - This building hereby permitted shall be used only for the repair and maintenance of vehicular ancillary to the permitted use of the site as a waste transfer station and for no other purpose.

Condition : 3 - REASONS FOR APPROVAL

The renewal of the planning permission is only acceptable on the basis that the continued use of the workshop is for vehicle maintenance, cleaning and repair, ancillary to the use of the site as a waste transfer station. The temporary nature of the planning permission is renewed for a reduced period of two (2) years to allow Council to flexibly considered comprehensive re-development of the surrounding Green Belt area and the adjoining Dean Jesmond site. The renewal of the planning permission is contrary to Council's UDP Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt) however it is considered that the renewal of the application it will not result in an intensification of the use, nor will it result in any additional detrimental impact to the Green Belt.
description: The renewal of permission 00095/R/P6 for the retention of existing vehicle workshop dated 24/01/01.
